notes: North-west Tucson (Oro Valley/Casas Adobes edge) on La Cholla Blvd. Denomination CONFIRMED on the church's own /affiliation page: the church 'is part of the Evangelical Covenant Church (ECC)'. Address confirmed in the church site footer as 9755 North La Cholla Boulevard, Tucson, AZ 85742; the coordinates are still only neighbourhood-level (geocode: approximate) and should be re-run with tools/geocode.py. YouTube channel confirmed as @GraceTucson (channel description reads 'Grace Community Church, Tucson, Arizona'); the 10:30 am service is livestreamed there, and the church also keeps its own sermon archive at mygrace.church/sermons indexed by speaker. The staff page lists Sam Gyorfi (Lead Pastor) and Janette Henson (Pastor of Worship & Church Life) as the only two pastors; both appear in the sermon-speaker index and Gyorfi preaches the large majority. Maddie Yager (Director of Youth Ministries) also appears in the speaker index but is not a pastor, so she is not listed here. The speaker index additionally contains Danny Hall, Joel Delp and Fred Nelson, who are not on the staff page and appear to be guest speakers - verify before treating any of them as regular preachers. The /leaders page lists only lay boards (Foundations Team, Operations Team, Leadership Search Team), not clergy. No sermon playlist URL was found on the YouTube channel; sermons appear as individual livestream videos.
